newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: US Kollmorgen, Swiss Gretag merge divisions.
newsitem.headline: US Kollmorgen, Swiss Gretag merge divisions.

text.p: Swiss Gretag AG and Kollmorgen Corp of Waltham, Mass. have decided to merge two of their divisions into Gretag Macbeth Holding AG, a joint statement said.
Gretag Macbeth is considering a public listing on the Swiss Exchange, the statement added.
Gretag and Kollmorgen said Gretag's Gretag Color Control Systems unit would be merged with the Macbeth division of Kollmorgen Instruments Corp, a unit of Kollmorgen Corp.
A spokesman for Macbeth said Gretag would own 52 percent of Gretag Macbeth Holding and Kollmorgen would own 48 percent.
The decision to create the company was taken on Wednesday and a decision on a listing would be taken over the next few months, Ronald Anderson of Macbeth said.
Gretag Macbeth had combined sales of around 65 million Swiss francs in 1996 and it will employ around 270 employees.

Gretag Macbeth will be among the top three companies worldwide in the market for color and appearance measurement and color management for the printing industry, a market that has a total size of $690 million.
